record.population: 126 patients with hydroquinone-associated ochronosis in 56 case reports
record.finding: Of cases, 55.5% were reported as Black and 52.4% were Fitzpatrick V-VI. Median use was 5 years; four cases came after 3 months or less and eight after a year or less. Concentrations above 4% were most often implicated. All had blue-black or grey-blue lace-like marks on the face; treatment is often unsatisfactory.
record.note: Case reports cannot give a risk rate; they show the harm exists and who it is reported in.
